_: FIRST Iowa Code chat eval set (corpus: iowa-code). This is eval set #1 for the IOWA CODE — it is NOT 'set 3'. The Iowa Court Rules have their own separate sets, chat_eval_court_rules.json (set 1) and chat_eval_court_rules_2.json (set 2); this file is independent of those and scored against the iowa-code source. Built 2026-06-01 from the cloned corpus. Covers high-traffic substantive Iowa law (limitations, consumer fraud, criminal, family, landlord-tenant, probate, business, employment, tax), includes a small-claims regression (the question that failed when scoped to Court Rules), definitions-heavy sections to stress internal-quote handling in the verification gate, and out-of-scope abstention checks (questions whose governing law is the Court Rules, not the Code). expected_paths are Node.path values verified to exist in the iowa-code corpus. Run with: manage.py probe_chat --queries apps/api/data/chat_eval_iowa_code_1.json --source iowa-code --model gpt-5-mini --json
